description: Credential-free Doris MCP Server digest-only token configuration template
notes: No usable credential is shipped with the server.
Create tokens through the protected management API or store a self-describing token_digest generated from a high-entropy bearer token.
Bearer token plaintext is returned only when a token is created and must not be written into this file.
Managed revocations are stored as digests and shared by all local worker processes.
Do not commit deployment credentials or usable token digests to source control.
